Chapter 6352: Attempt

Chapter 6352: Attempt

“Boom!” A majestic power with a green hue erupted and pulsed outward.

“Hmm?” Everyone in Desolate Frontier looked up at the sky.

“That’s Idle Peak.” An elder said.

“I’ve never heard of it before.” The disciples nearby became confused.

“Yes, Driedtree Emperor is staying there.” The elder responded.

Idle was a peak near the ancestral one. It used to be nameless but after Li Qiye infused a leaf for the emperor, it gained a name.

The peak was fully activated and released boundless life force. An imperial aura swept through the world, forcing everyone into submission.

This was an apex imperial aura, easily suppressing emperors and desolate gods. As the light intensified, an anima tree emerged and blotted out the sky.

It pierced into space and became colossal. Stars circled the branches.

Regular disciples were astounded, having never seen such an apex emperor’s anima tree in its entirety.

“Boom!” The momentum of Desolate Frontier activated, preventing anyone from entering or leaving.

“What’s going on?” Others didn’t expect the lockdown.

“Driedtree Emperor is facing a tribulation of the primal level.” Protectors and elders speculated.

“Boom!” A supreme grand dao with the appearance of yellow soil wanted to lift the firmaments. It gave the impression of having existed since antiquity.

For some reason, everyone became sentimental after seeing it and recalled the past. As they grew stronger, their loved ones returned to the earth, leaving them all alone.

This yellow grand dao emitted life force like the return of spring. The anima tree sent its strands of power covering all of Desolate Frontier. These strands felt like water to those touched by them.

Meanwhile, the supreme grand dao gave birth to divine rings made from dao laws. They evolved constantly and derived more dao.

Their purpose was not to create the dao but rather to protect the supreme grand dao and keep it firmly in place.

“The limit path.” Some knew about this phenomenon - the divine rings shackling the supreme grand dao.

Juniors heard this and watched in amazement. The limit path was beyond the reason of virtually all cultivators. Becoming an emperor and desolate god was difficult enough, let alone reach this final stage.

“Clank!” The supreme grand dao shook violently and grew larger, attempting to break the divine rings. Driedtree Emperor floated at the center of this event.

Spectators observed and felt how this grand dao was not the origin of her power.

“The limit is a prison.” A desolate god said.

This path was the only way to obtain a primal anima. However, it also trapped a cultivator forever until a breakthrough. This was the reason why these apex cultivators disappeared during their training.

“Go!” Driedtree’s true fate appeared, giving her more power to shake the divine ring loose.

“Limit breaking.” Ten-realm Emperor observed from a distance, alarmed.

“She’s doing it, breaking the limit to obtain a primal anima.” Spectators understood her intent.

“It’s been a long time.” One ancestor said sentimentally.

Perhaps no one in Old World has been on the limit path longer than Driedtree Emperor. Seeing this attempt made people think of Ten-realm Emperor - another cultivator on the same path.
